pass: Plays down or dodges her thanks: jokes, claims it was nothing or an accident, or changes the subject; getting her name wrong is fine. Does not promise to stay in Omui. No anger and no stance change.

beliefs.label: a proud girl in a fine riding dress, the lord of Omui's daughter

earlier: Yesterday Ren saved this girl's carriage from bandits. On the way to town he grumbled about how dull Omui is, before finding out she is the lord's daughter.
Her father has given Ren a reward and a town pass. Ren wants to go back to his forest.

seen.label: a proud girl in a fine riding dress, the lord of Omui's daughter
seen.activityLook: standing in front of him with her chin up and a purse of gold in her hand

dialogue.spoken: You saved my life, so I'll say it properly: thank you. Father insists you take this gold. And you are not leaving Omui until you admit it's worth staying for. Also, my name is Elena, not 'carriage girl'.
